title: GenWave Icon Pack Catalog Entry Metadata
description: The <slug>.meta.json shape for a kind:"icon" entry (app repo SPEC F130.6, catalog-owned). Mirrors font-meta.schema.json's posture (additionalProperties false — an unrecognized field is a contributor mistake worth failing CI on) with ONE deliberate difference: `license` and `sourceUrl` are REQUIRED here, not carried by the manifest at all. SPEC F130.1's gw-icon-pack document is deliberately closed (style + icons, nothing else); F130.6 (amended 2026-08-16 at the T305 review, PLAN T309's own line) rules that an icon pack's licence + provenance — MIT icon sets as raw material, attributed, the FONTS.md posture at a lighter weight — live HERE instead. tools/validate.py's icon-licence-in-manifest gate is the other half of this ruling: a `license`/`licence` member found inside <slug>.icon.json is a HARD rejection, since IconPackDefinitionSerializer's own re-serialization would silently drop it, leaving a contributor's licence text unattributed the moment the pack installs.
$comment: `added`'s pattern ends in (?![\s\S]), the same portable absolute-end-of-string anchor persona-meta.schema.json/theme-meta.schema.json/font-meta.schema.json document in full and repeat verbatim — repeated here too so this file stands alone.

author.description: Who curated/converted this pack. Icon packs are Dean-curated only (SPEC F130.6/F130.7, the FONTS.md precedent) — no community pack submissions — but the field stays uniform with every other kind's own `author`.

description.description: A short blurb introducing the pack — shown on the shelf card without fetching the manifest.

audience.description: Content self-rating, verified at review (mirrors every other kind's own `audience`; icon glyphs are rarely mature, but the field stays uniform so the shelf's rating logic never branches on `kind`).

added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this pack was added to the catalog. `format: date` alone is annotation-only in draft-07 by default, so `pattern` carries the shape enforcement — but pattern alone only checks digit counts, not calendar validity; tools/validate.py separately parses this value with datetime.date.fromisoformat to reject a shape-valid but non-existent date.

license.description: The upstream MIT (or equivalent permissive) icon set's licence identifier/text (SPEC F130.6, tools/IconPackAuthor's own IconPackMetaSkeleton field of the same name) — REQUIRED here, and HARD-forbidden inside the companion <slug>.icon.json (tools/validate.py's icon-licence-in-manifest gate).

sourceUrl.description: Canonical upstream icon set URL (mirrors font-manifest.schema.json's own `sourceUrl` — the FONTS.md provenance-record precedent, lighter weight per F130.6). Anchored to the scheme prefix only, enough to reject an `http://`, `javascript:`, or schemeless value.

version.description: Upstream tag/commit/release, when determinable — mirrors font-manifest.schema.json's own `version`. Null-tolerant on purpose (tools/IconPackAuthor's authoring script emits `null` when none was given).

bestFor.description: Optional use-case hints — mirrors every other kind's own `bestFor`.
